items.q: Yes, but his name rang out the most. ... yes, there was a Basil Stone, a trumpet player, who turned out to be a preacher in St. Louis

ctx.x: Who were you acquainted with in the bands? Were you acquainted with any of the members of the bands?
Yes, but his name rang out the most. I don't have a total recall of -- yes, there was a Basil Stone, a trumpet player, who turned out to be a preacher in St. Louis,
